route: Explicit geometric arm constraints plus bounded local curves; not native ARDY generation or adapter training.
execution: Actual Animator / Player LateUpdate / VRM LateUpdate / observer12000 / independent test12500. No manual Tick, Animator.Update or VRM Process.
rendering: Approximately20Hz actual live poses, each frame BakeMesh; exact frameCount/gameTime/realtime recorded. No resampling or pose corrections.
expressions: Real BlinkController and Audio2LipScript.Update on NEVA Humanoid; synthetic aa input only, no audio playback or network.
dialogueLifecycle: Inactive ChatSample prevents Awake/Start/network; its actual dispatch and cancellation events run through the real Bridge and Controller into live constraints. User-speaking/hold/TTL/current/explicit-stop are verified on subsequent actual frames.
limitation: Isolated imported models and actual update loops. Geometric/lifecycle acceptance does not automatically establish subjective naturalness or scene-specific collisions.

acceptedScope.route: geometric constraints plus bounded local curve
limitations: These are concrete combinations, not exhaustive coverage of every permitted plan or a claim that native ARDY generation improved.
No actual Qwen generation, TTS audio or external network service was started by this harness.
Expression coexistence uses real Blink/Audio2Lip Update but synthetic aa input, not real audio synchronisation.
Root visual review found the outward pose left fingertip cropped in the preview. Geometric measurements still use the complete actual skeleton; do not claim full image framing.
Scene-specific clothing/body collisions and visual naturalness require manual review.
